Name: Magic Greenhouse Gateway
Author: Wandox99
Description:
Hello everyone!
This mod replace the greenhouse with a Magic Gateway.
You can choose from various colors and animation:
Black;
Blue;
Brown;
Green;
Orange;
Pink;
Purple;
Red;
Sky Blue;
Yellow.
Or just a backgrounded gateway like
Woods 1;
Woods 2;
Woods 3;
Woods - No animations. (As the name say, this one has no animation frame, so you don't need Content Patcher Animations)







I made this mod because:
I love the concept of Gateway/Portals.
I want an excuse for having a greenhouse that inside can have a really large amount of space withou giving the idea of ​​the T.A.R.D.I.S. effect ([b]Bigger on the Inside[/b]).

[size=5]READ THIS
[/size]When you use this mod on an old save you may notice that the greenhouse need more space than it needs, for resolve this download [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7814]ModifyThis[/url] and use it for remove the old greenhouse, then use this on the command console:
debug build Greenhouse 27 12
for the fourcorners farm map it should be:
debug build Greenhouse 26 29
on the island farm map it should be:
debug build Greenhouse 12 25
WARNING: you will lost the items and crops on the old greenhouse, recover what you can before doing this!

Thanks to﻿ [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/41209805]lastinglife[/url] for discover how to fix this!


I recommend to use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8203]Greenhouse Entry Begone[/url] Mod: It help with the not-so-beatiful Greenhouse entry, and in fact, it give 6 more free tile, but for game logic, when you change the position of the gateway, the entry is still there and maybe it can be annoying, but that can be avoided placing the gateway first and then making change on farm.

This mod was meant to be used with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15443]Magic Grenhouse Garden[/url], but it's not obligatory.


[size=5]Install[/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url].
3. Download this mod.
4. Unzip it and choose [u]ONLY ONE[/u] from the folder and put it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
5. Run the game using SMAPI.


[size=4]If you liked the mod, please leave an endorsement![/size]



If you have suggestion or feedback feel free to write me on the [url=http://discord.gg/stardewvalley]official Discord server[/url] with the tag @Wandox#6064 in the modmaking channels
